summary: The PR addresses the issue of slight differences in KMeans results based on the number of jobs, but introduces non-minimal changes and potential maintainability issues.

issues.description: The PR introduces non-minimal changes by moving the generation of seeds outside the conditional block for `n_jobs`. This could lead to confusion and potential bugs if not well understood.
The code becomes less readable due to the introduction of an unnecessary variable `seeds` that is only used in the single-threaded case. This adds complexity without clear benefit.
